events.name: BIPOC Community Run @ Highland
events.venue: 767 Cleveland Ave S (Mill City Running Highland)
events.description: Bringing more diversity to the sport we love: this monthly meetup is for members of the community who are Black, Indigenous, and/or People of Color (BIPOC). Just like all our runs this is free and will offer 2, 3, 4.5, and 7 mile options. Pace groups will represent all speeds and have designated leaders to guide you along the route. All BIPOC movers are welcome! This run is held on the second Thursday of each month, beginning at 6pm. We alternate between Northeast (even months) and Highland (odd months). events.name: Flapjack Friday @ Northeast
events.venue: 411 E Hennepin Ave (Mill City Running Northeast)
events.description: Early bird gets the miles. What started as a dozen runners getting together in 2013 has become an iconic weekend warmup in Minneapolis. With route options of 2, 4, 5, or 7 miles, you'll share miles with a variety of experience levels and pace preferences. Our 6:30 am Friday run happens every week, all year long, always featuring fountains and fountains of fresh coffee. This week is extra special because we'll be flipping Flapjacks with our friends from Seven Sundays! Are you an overachiever looking for some extra credit? Sign the one-time waiver before your first run. Find the routes and FAQs

events.name: Highland Community Run
events.venue: 767 Cleveland Ave S (Mill City Running Highland)
events.description: Bringing the party to Saint Paul. Join us every Monday night in Highland Park for a free community run. Choose from routes ranging from 2–7 miles, with pace groups for everyone—from sub-7-minute miles to 13+ minute miles, plus a welcoming walking crew. Every other week we rotate between two route options, and Team Northbound vs. Team Southbound remains one of the shop's most hotly debated rivalries. Looking for a little extra credit? Save time at check-in by signing the one-time waiver before your first run. Check out the routes and FAQs here.

events.name: BROOKS Demo Run @ Northeast
events.venue: 411 E Hennepin Ave (Mill City Running Northeast)
events.description: Grab a friend and drop in on the most social run in Minneapolis, this week with free demo shoes from Brooks Running (and a special surprise after the run)! Our weekly Tuesday run takes you through the historic Marcy-Holmes neighborhood and Minneapolis Parks System with 2, 4, 5, and 7 mile loops. Like all of our runs you’ll find a variety of paces from sub-7 minute miles to over 13 minutes per mile and walkers (we promise, someone is moving your pace). Looking for a little extra credit? Save time at check-in by signing the one-time waiver before your first run. Check out the routes and FAQs her

events.name: Assisted Long Run @ Northeast
events.venue: 411 E Hennepin Ave (Mill City Running Northeast)
events.description: Our Assisted Long Run is hosted about every other week (ok…twice a month) and includes pre-mapped routes ranging from 6-20 miles. Along the course you’ll find multiple aid stations where runners have the opportunity to hydrate and refuel. We update the start time to match the daylight during the seasons. ALRs start at 7:00AM from May through September, and 8:00AM from October through April. Routes can be found here .
